title: I Turned My Mini-Courses Into a Custom Learning Portal With Claude
description:
marketwithmark.com

Most people think Claude is just a chatbot.

I used it to take all of my mini-courses, organize them, structure the curriculum, and package everything into a custom learning portal in a fraction of the time it would have taken manually.

This is what happens when you stop using AI for simple tasks and start using it as your development team.
